label: conformance vectors for prereg-ci's fence and RESULT readers on the B3 review's shapes; no claim

rules.id: sha256 of the sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON of {name, inputs: {info, text}}
rules.text: inputs.text names bytes in this file's blobs by sha256 ({utf8} or {b64}); fence_json reads them decoded as UTF-8 with CRLF and a lone CR read as LF, and is absent for bytes that are not UTF-8; candidate and reading are handed the bytes
rules.fence_json: styxx.prereg_ci.core._fence_json(text, info): {line, object}, {none: true}, or {raises, message}

vectors.name: result/encoding/utf-16-le-bom-fence

reading.detail: the document is UTF-16-LE (it starts with that byte-order mark), and read that way it holds the marker of a form (a fence whose info string reads result or holds a non-ASCII character, or a sworn tag naming a verdict leaf); a RESULT is read as UTF-8, so nothing in it is read
